apps.name: My Queue
apps.description: Save the thing, and the reason you saved it: your queue in its own window on Windows.

screens.caption: Open www.jayteesf.com/apps/my-queue/ in Microsoft Edge and click Download for Windows.
Edge may hold the download: "Make sure you trust MyQueue-Setup-0.2.1.exe before you open it". It says Publisher: Unknown because this test build is not signed yet.

On your own PC, click the arrow next to Delete, then Keep anyway. Then open the file from Edge's Downloads list and click through the installer. If Windows says "Windows protected your PC", choose More info, then Run anyway.
When the installer finishes, My Queue opens in its own window, with its own taskbar icon. Sign in or create an account.
Next time, find it in the Start menu: search for My Queue.
It is listed in Settings, Apps, Installed apps, with version 0.2.1 and publisher JayTeeSF LLC.
After you choose Uninstall in Settings and again in the My Queue Uninstall window, it says Uninstallation Complete.
